meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装了这个技能，Claude 探索代码时不会直接打开整个文件，而是先扫描文件结构，再按需展开你关心的部分。它会产出结构骨架、匹配的函数列表和单个函数/类的完整源码，节省阅读量。
howto.when: 当你的请求涉及理解代码结构、查找函数或高效浏览代码库时，Claude 会改用结构搜索，先给你代码地图，再按需展开细节。

say.text: 帮我找出代码里所有和 shutdown 相关的函数。
say.note: 它会搜索并列出匹配的函数和位置。

say.text: 看看 worker-service.ts 这个文件的结构。
say.note: 它会给出文件里的函数和类清单。

say.text: 展开 performGracefulShutdown 方法的完整实现。
say.note: 它只显示该函数的代码。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude won't open whole files while exploring code. It first scans the structure, then expands only the parts you care about, returning structural skeletons, ranked symbol lists, and full source of individual functions/classes to save tokens.
howto.when_en: Used when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or efficiently explore a codebase. Claude switches to structural search, giving you a map before details.

say_en.text: Find all functions related to shutdown in the code.
say_en.note: It searches and lists matching functions with locations.
It returns the file's function and class list.

say_en.text: Expand the full implementation of performGracefulShutdown.
say_en.note: It shows only that function's code.
